instruction: Activate the switch at the lightweight plastic switch angled edges

source.instruction: Activate the switch at the lightweight plastic switch angled edges

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the switch, which was at x = -2 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Close right gripper to form a pushing tip.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 43 cm (horizontal) / +12 cm (vertical) from the switch; closed the gripper (opening 0.00: nothing held)

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.00; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper towards switch to (1, 4, 94).
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-30, +23, +0) cm, now 5 cm (horizontal) / +13 cm (vertical) from the switch

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (1, 4, 94) opening 0.00; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate right gripper to align with switch angled edge and lower to z=80.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-1, -0, -14) cm, now 5 cm (horizontal) / -2 cm (vertical) from the switch

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (0, 4, 80) opening 0.00; table z = 74
frames.plan: Push forward and left against the switch edge to activate it.
